actions.text: Editing any field stores a pending change; the page is marked as having pending changes until saved.
Pressing save sends the settings with the changed values merged in to the server and clears pending changes on success.
Pressing the API key reset button opens a confirmation (Reset API Key); confirming runs the reset API key command.
In the restart-required dialog, Restart Now triggers a server restart and Restart Later closes the dialog.

rules.text: Port Number, SSL Port and Proxy Port accept values from 1 to 65535.
Log Size Limit accepts values from 1 to 10 MB.
After a successful save that changed a restart-requiring setting, a restart-required dialog opens.
The restart dialog adds a Windows service note when the app runs as a Windows service.
When an API key reset finishes, the browser page reloads once saving is not in progress.
The same command is not run again within 5 seconds; the repeat is ignored.
Save validation errors and warnings (HTTP 400) are matched to fields by property name and shown on the form.
The Branch field is read-only when an external update mechanism is used.

shows.text: The page is titled "General" under the "Settings" scope and contains sections for Host, Security, Proxy, Logging, Analytics, Updates and Backups.
While settings are loading for the first time, a loading indicator is shown.
If loading fails, an error alert shows the general settings load error message and the form is hidden.
The Host section has Bind Address, Port Number, Url Base, Allowed Hosts, Instance Name, Application URL and Enable SSL fields.
SSL Port, SSL Cert Path, SSL Key Path and SSL Cert Password are shown only when Enable SSL is checked.
The Open Browser On Start checkbox is shown only on Windows when the app is not running as a service.
The Security section has Authentication, API Key, Certificate Validation and Trusted Networks fields. Authentication Required is shown only when the authentication method is not 'none'.
With the 'forms' authentication method, Username, Password and Password Confirmation fields are shown.
With the 'oidc' authentication method, Authority, Client Id, Client Secret, User Identifier and Scopes fields are shown.
The API key field is read-only, with a copy button and a reset button; the reset icon spins while a reset is running.
The Proxy section shows a Use Proxy checkbox. Type, Hostname, Port, Username, Password, Ignored Addresses and Bypass Proxy For Local Addresses appear only when it is checked.
Proxy type options are HTTP(S), Socks4 and Socks5.
The Logging section has a Log Level select, with a warning shown when the level is 'trace', and a Log Size Limit in MB.
The Analytics section has a checkbox to send anonymous usage data, with a restart-required warning.
The Updates section is shown only when advanced settings are shown. It has Branch, Automatic, Mechanism and, for the 'script' mechanism, Script Path.
The Mechanism options are the external package mechanism (title-cased) or Built-in, plus Script.
The Backups section is shown only when advanced settings are shown. It has Folder, Interval (days) and Retention (days).

sideEffects.text: Saving sends a PUT of the settings to the general settings API path and updates the cached settings with the response.
Confirming restart sends POST /system/restart, then marks the app as restarting and starts pinging the server until it responds.
Resetting the API key posts a command to /command and adds it to the cached command list.
